title: First General Meeting
caption: An opportunity to bring students together around data analytics, technical learning, and community.

heading: Building a Community
body: Before the club existed, there wasn't really a space on campus for students who wanted to go deeper into data together. Building that space - workshops, a speaker series, mentorship, projects people actually cared about - became the thing I'm proudest of starting from zero.

title: ASA Best Data Insight Winners
caption: Led students to Chicago to compete in ASA DataFest, where our team won the Best Insight award.

heading: Chicago
body: Taking a team to Chicago for DataFest meant late nights with real data, real deadlines, and a group of people who trusted each other enough to compete together. Winning Best Insight was proof the club could hold its own.

heading: Learning From Others
body: IBM TechXchange was a chance to step outside Augustana and see how the technology I was learning in class gets used at scale - and to come back with new ideas for what the club, and the students in it, could try next.

heading: Student Leadership
body: As a Resident Advisor, I was responsible for 96 students across apartments and houses, planning events and building a community they actually wanted to be part of. As Multi Cultural Programing Board Co-Chair, I helped organize campus events with real cultural significance. As Marketing Chair for Student Government, I ran the social media accounts that gave campus life its voice.

title: Augustana's First Datathon
caption: Organized the first datathon event at Augustana College.

heading: Where Research Meets Data
body: My research with Dr. Corts sits right at the intersection I care about most: using data and analysis to understand how memory and attention actually work, not just what the textbook says they should.

title: MPA Poster Presentation
caption: Presented a directed forgetting research project.
